ai_summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL) reported an 11% Y-o-Y revenue growth to INR 2,026 crores in Q1 FY27, driven by strong expansion in newer businesses and steady performance in established segments. However, the company posted an increased net loss of INR 249 crores, primarily due to continued heavy investments in scaling new ventures (such as OWND, which is not yet profitable at a format level) and higher depreciation/finance costs. While operational EBITDA, excluding treasury income, improved, current profitability remains pressured by these strategic growth expenditures, with the company projecting to be Free Cash Flow positive only by FY29-30.
